records.title: Reserved saved-evidence review
Separate saved-evidence review

The frozen report, manifest, telemetry and artifact identities consistently support the narrow report-only feasibility claim. Empty candidate.diff and changed_paths establish no proposed source delivery requiring physics gates. Authentication and protocol provenance have the stated inspection limits.

checks.description: Inspected the report-only claim at source revision 8acde0c21d5b9db8893115e3e79d82d9e41f98ca, empty candidate diff, producer validation and completed experiment manifest. Manifest records rust-native physics, 100 steps, dt 0.002 s and native artifact build identity.

Verified every frozen asset SHA-256 against manifest.json. Parsed saved telemetry and independently checked exactly 101 rows with consecutive steps 0 through 100, ending at 0.2 s. Confirmed empty commands and RRD size 1494557 bytes. These are saved-artifact checks, not numerical reproduction.

Inspected adapter dispatch, actor binding, completion hash checks and explicit permission limitation. Parent chat owns authenticated cloud sessions; the adapter does not enforce requested CLI sandbox flags or provide unattended dispatch.

limitations: Support is confined to one reported launcher-attached HP3 idle experiment and its consistent saved artifacts. No fresh physics, fitting or numerical reproduction was performed.

The frozen submission does not include the report-linked MCP transcript, reproducible probe or production-result.json. Direct protocol execution and absence of additional credentials therefore remain producer-reported rather than independently established by those frozen assets.
RRD file identity and size were independently checked. RRD sample coverage and blueprint readability remain producer-reported because rerun.dataframe was unavailable in the reviewer interpreter.
The cloud platform permission profile applies. Read-only review was an instruction, not an additional enforced filesystem sandbox. The adapter explicitly disclaims enforcement of CLI sandbox flags.
This does not establish calibration accuracy, hardware performance, interruption/recovery, unattended broker operation, nested CLI management or full manager release readiness.

The two historical 100-step runtime records and separate 100-step managed record support the stated narrow scope. The report correctly treats calibration improvement and full unattended operation as untested by these records. The candidate diff is empty and no source delivery is proposed.

checks.description: Inspected the frozen report and abstract for the exact evidence-limit claim and separation of runtime feasibility from calibration and unattended lifecycle claims.

Compared saved step counts, recording metadata, run identities, zero-fit scope and reported artifact hashes. Independently verified all five frozen asset hashes against the manifest; inspected the empty candidate diff. No numerical reproduction or underlying recording inspection.

limitations: The frozen validation records report producer checks; this review did not decode RRD files, inspect underlying experimental artifacts or reproduce numerical results.

The frozen assets contain no calibration comparison or full lifecycle acceptance evidence. Their absence supports an evidence-limit finding, not a failed calibration result or a release-status determination.
